elements.element: The transition obligations apply upon either expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: The added language applies “upon expiry or termination of this Agreement or any Statement of Work for any reason.”

elements.element: Contractor must provide transition assistance to Company.
elements.evidence: Contractor must, “at Company's request, provide reasonable transition assistance.”

elements.element: Transition assistance must be available for up to six (6) months.
elements.evidence: The assistance is expressly required “for up to six (6) months.”

elements.element: Transition assistance is provided at Contractor's then-current rates.
elements.evidence: The clause expressly specifies “at Contractor's then-current rates.”

elements.element: Contractor must return all Company Data to Company.
elements.evidence: Contractor must “return all Company data” to Company.

elements.element: Company Data must be returned within thirty (30) days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: The return obligation is stated to occur “within thirty (30) days” following the expiry-or-termination trigger.

elements.element: Company Data must be returned in a standard machine-readable format.
elements.evidence: The clause requires return “in a commonly used, machine-readable format,” which satisfies a standard machine-readable format requirement.

elements.element: Contractor must delete Company Data after returning it.
elements.evidence: After the return requirement, Contractor must “thereafter delete such data … from its systems.”

elements.element: Contractor must certify deletion of Company Data after deletion.
elements.evidence: Contractor must “certify such deletion in writing.”

elements.element: Following expiry or termination, Contractor must provide transition assistance for at least a ninety (90)-day transition period.
elements.evidence: The clause makes transition assistance available at Company's request “for up to six (6) months,” encompassing a requested ninety-day period.

elements.element: Contractor must export Company Data within thirty (30) days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: Contractor must return all Company data within thirty days in a commonly used, machine-readable format, satisfying the data-export requirement.

result.reason: The redline satisfies every preferred requirement and therefore also the fallback. It is not minimal because it additionally requires return and deletion of all Confidential Information and materials, beyond the stated Customer Data requirements. Those additions do not negate the existing commercial terms or create a direct contradiction. Drafting is generally clear, though applying a machine-readable-format requirement to all “materials” may be awkward for physical or non-digital items.
